checks.rationale: All five depicted action blocks are represented by local operations and actual preparation boundaries. The far-left nucleosome overview illustrates the assay target; it is not another routed workflow. card.description_verbatim:
scATAC-seq is ATAC-seq integrated into a programmable microfluidics platform The method is similar to single cell ATAC-seq, which relies on indexing to identify single cells.
In this protocol the cells are captured in a fluidics device, lysed and subjected to Tn5 transposases. The Tn5 ends are extended, PCR amplified with dual-index primers, pooled, purified, and sequenced.
advantages_verbatim: Map the accessible genome of individual cells

Pros:
Map the accessible genome of individual cells

Requires dedicated fluidics
